name: Ghost
tagline: Ghost is a free and open source blogging platform
description: Ghost is a free and open source blogging platform written in JavaScript and distributed under the MIT License, designed to simplify the process of online publishing for individual bloggers as well as online publications.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Database connection password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Services used in the application
services:
  # The `app` service for the Ghost application
  app:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-ghost
    # Docker image to be used
    image: ghost:6.72.0-alpine@sha256:cd617a0901e659cda978b9063f449535d105f5f1a0340ffac415db2c42d22606
    # Restart policy for the service
    restart: on-failure
    # Networks used by the service
    networks:
      - ghost-network
    environment:
      # Database configuration for Ghost (see Ghost documentation for more details)
      database__client: mysql
      database__connection__host: db
      database__connection__user: ghost
      database__connection__password: ${SECRET_DATABASE_CONNECTION_PASSWORD}
      database__connection__database: ghost
      # Base URL for the Ghost application
      url: "http://localhost:2368"
      # Note on NODE_ENV default value for this image
      #NODE_ENV: development
    # Volume mappings for persistent storage
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/content:/var/lib/ghost/content
    # Port mappings for the service
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:2368"
    # Dependencies for the service
    depends_on:
      - db
  # The `db` service for database (MySQL in this case)
  db:
    # Container name
    container_name: big-bear-ghost-db
    # Docker image to be used
    image: mysql:8.0@sha256:7dcddc01f13bab2f15cde676d44d01f61fc9f99fe7785e86196dfc07d358ae2b
    # Restart policy for the service
    restart: on-failure
    # Volume mappings for persistent storage
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
    # MySQL environment variables
    environment:
      MYSQL_USER: "ghost"
      MYSQL_DATABASE: "ghost"
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DATABASE_CONNECTION_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DATABASE_CONNECTION_PASSWORD}
    # Networks used by the service
    networks:
      - ghost-network
# Networks used by the application
networks:
  # Define the network for AdGuard Home
  ghost-network:
    driver: bridge
